section_summary: This section finishes a Japanese inheritance and gift tax bill, covering valuation, returns, collection, penalties, transitional rules, and the reason for the bill. It then contains two copies of an Industrial Reconstruction Corporation bill, each accompanied by a cover and errata sheet. The final pages begin a bill governing trade corporations.

subfiles.title: Inheritance Tax Law bill, continuation
subfiles.about: Reforms inheritance and gift taxation in Japan.
subfiles.summary: The remaining articles set gift tax exemptions and rates, property valuation rules, filing and collection procedures, appeals, relief, investigative powers, and penalties. Supplementary provisions address territorial application, transition rules, and registration tax amendments; the final page states the reason for the bill.

subfiles.title: Industrial Reconstruction Corporation Bill cover
subfiles.about: Identifies the Industrial Reconstruction Corporation bill.
subfiles.summary: Japanese title page for the bill.

subfiles.title: Errata to Industrial Reconstruction Corporation bill
subfiles.about: Corrects and supplements provisions of the corporation bill.
subfiles.summary: Corrects wording and deadlines and supplies omitted penalty text.

subfiles.title: Industrial Reconstruction Corporation Law bill, first copy
subfiles.about: Establishes a government financed corporation to support industrial recovery.
subfiles.summary: The bill establishes the Industrial Reconstruction Corporation with its principal office in Tokyo and sets its capital, officers, and duties concerning industrial equipment and materials. It regulates finance, accounting, supervision, and penalties, then provides for succession from the earlier Industrial Equipment Corporation and related legal amendments.

subfiles.title: Industrial Reconstruction Corporation Bill cover, second copy
subfiles.about: Identifies another copy of the Industrial Reconstruction Corporation bill.
subfiles.summary: Title page with Japanese and partly legible English headings.

subfiles.title: Errata to Industrial Reconstruction Corporation bill, second copy
subfiles.about: Corrects and supplements the second copy of the bill.
subfiles.summary: Lists wording corrections and omitted penalty text.

subfiles.title: Industrial Reconstruction Corporation Law bill, second copy
subfiles.about: Presents another copy of the law establishing the Industrial Reconstruction Corporation.
subfiles.summary: This copy repeats provisions on the corporation’s purpose, Tokyo office, capital, personnel, industrial recovery work, and oversight. Later provisions address accounts, transfer of facilities and materials, penalties, succession from the earlier corporation, and amendments to other laws.

subfiles.title: Trade Corporations Law bill, opening pages
subfiles.about: Provides for trade corporations handling imports, exports, and associated materials.
subfiles.summary: The opening provisions describe trade corporations, including a raw materials trade corporation, and set rules for their organization, officers, and tax treatment. They specify import and export functions, business plans, accounts, and government supervision; the bill continues beyond this section.
